target_state_summary: A versioned, fail-closed Swarm coding-fleet control plane whose parent/child authority can only narrow, whose workflow units own specialist refinement and invocation, whose exact routes and workflow evidence are machine validated, whose supervisor fences generations, budgets, cancellation and file/symbol ownership, whose Factory mutations are transactional and catalog-confined, whose Claude and Antigravity orchestrators receive only a typed lifecycle tool, and whose bounded two-pass verification behavior is proven locally and on LXC 135 without model, benchmark, scorer, gold, hidden, history, or issue-web access.
success_measures: Authority expansion, direct orchestrator-to-leaf invocation, ambiguous or unavailable routes, stale generations, forged results, missing proof, budget oversubscription, and ownership conflicts all reject deterministically.
Canonical catalog, runtime admission, Claude, Codex, and Antigravity projections express identical authority, selection, route, and evidence semantics.

A workflow-result envelope is accepted only when its current generation, route, authority, repository snapshot, artifacts, commands, checks, and evidence obligations reconcile; process exit zero alone is never success.
Cancellation durably fences admission, cascades through descendants, drains processes and events, releases reservations and leases, and records late output as audit-only.
Factory can modify only the canonical specialist catalog, generated projections, and installer-owned harness state, with byte-and-metadata preimages, validation, rollback, and fresh-session proof.
The default verification policy performs two total independent verification passes with at most one targeted repair and terminates as accepted, exhausted, cancelled, blocked, or no-progress.
Provider-free local adapter conformance and remote LXC 135 compile, import, projection, and conformance checks pass without a model call or benchmark attempt.
Remote model, thinking, and message settings remain exactly google/gemini-3.7-flash, THINKING_BUDGET=65535, and message_limit=100.
Final independent Code Review and Coding Evaluation produce valid current-generation evidence envelopes with no unresolved high-severity finding.
assumptions: The authoritative sidecar is docs/plans/solution-plan.json, SHA-256 b9fc7439413aa7c41344246706c4ff1e60ac4ab306bb806e7a0fd641c4c6eaa2, size 5,223 bytes.
The implementation baseline is the current 119-entry working tree: 82 tracked modifications and 37 untracked files, status digest eda32a1a4e8a2042bfe5e621f44322d1ea6139a15c45ae7110283ef5de9b352f.
All current runplane/ and cmd/swarm-runplane/ files are untracked user work and must be patched in place, never replaced from Git or the recovery backup.
controlplane/ is the selected shared-contract package; placing these contracts in runplane would invert the existing dependency from runplane to codingfleet.
The initial supported verification range is one or two total passes, default two. Increasing the hard maximum requires a later reviewed contract version.

Installed-version discovery must prove exact Claude and Antigravity MCP registration and tool names before projections are enabled. Unsupported registration blocks that adapter; it never triggers a shell fallback.
Nexus task import remains pending and every board_task_ref remains null until the CLI is reachable and [I###] titles are reconciled.
LXC mutation, promotion, and any cold reload execute only under the goal's explicit remote-operation authority and after a fresh backup manifest.
Every implementation, review, evaluation, and remote-operation assignment uses gpt-5.6-sol at max; no isolated task is low-risk enough to justify Terra for this scope.
global_invariants: Preserve HEAD and every unrelated dirty-worktree byte; reconcile overlapping files before editing.
Coding Orchestrator invokes only the seven peer workflow units. Workflow units alone refine and invoke technical/domain leaves.
No specialist pool is mandatory; an empty selected set is valid when reasons and evidence support it.
Research, Planner, Code Review, Debugger, and Coding Evaluation remain read-only; Executor owns target-project writes; Factory owns only fleet catalog/projection/install surfaces.
Authority is parent intersection canonical ceiling intersection requested narrowing intersection observed harness capability; missing or incomparable dimensions deny.
Provider, family, exact model, and effort never silently substitute.
Unknown contract fields and incompatible major versions reject.
Exit code zero, narrative claims, or writer-owned tests cannot independently establish completion.
No unrestricted shell, arbitrary executable, argv, URL, or filesystem path is accepted through the structured lifecycle tool.
No model or paid-provider calls, benchmark execution, scorer calls, gold patches, hidden tests/results, scorer metadata, prior solutions, history, or issue-web searches.
Generated projections are changed only through codingfleet.Render/SyncRendered.
Remote /opt/evals/benchmarks/swe_bench_fleet.py is validation-only and must preserve t.message_limit = 100.
out_of_scope: Product-agent feature work, GitHub App/code-review implementation, registry redesign, UI work, cloud deployment, paid evaluation, benchmark scoring, merge/push/commit, and unrelated cleanup.
Changing the remote model, thinking budget, message limit, benchmark data, scorer, or port 8888 service.
Broadening Factory into a generic target-project writer.
Supporting more than two verification passes in this contract version.

phases.title: Add generation-safe durable supervision

changes.title: Aggregate budget ledger and atomic admission
changes.description: Reserve, debit, release, and reconcile goal-wide descendant budgets atomically.
preconditions: Route work to gpt-5.6-sol/max.

steps: Implement wall time, turns/messages, tool calls, input/output tokens when observed, child count/concurrency, and optional cost ceilings.

Persist ledger events and reconcile conservation after restart.
acceptance_criteria: Concurrent children cannot reserve more than the parent aggregate.
Unknown usage is not treated as zero.
Reserved equals consumed plus released plus active for every persisted goal.
behavior_to_preserve: Existing global concurrency cap remains an additional ceiling.
tests_required: Race-enabled reserve/debit/release, over-budget, cancellation, unknown usage, restart and conservation tests.

changes.title: Shared file and symbol ownership registry

preconditions: Route work to gpt-5.6-sol/max.

steps: Define repository-relative exact/prefix path leases and language-qualified symbol leases such as go://runplane.Supervisor.Cancel.
Resolve symlinks and reject traversal/root escape before admission.
Detect identical, prefix/containing path, and identical/containing symbol conflicts.
Use earlier admitted current-generation dispatch as the deterministic winner.
Fall back conservatively to the containing file when symbol resolution is unavailable.
Persist and release leases on all terminal, cancellation and recovery paths.
acceptance_criteria: Read-only work and disjoint writers coexist.
Overlapping writers resolve deterministically under concurrent admission.
Traversal, symlink escape and ambiguous symbols reject.
behavior_to_preserve: Existing path-only conflict cases remain rejected.
tests_required: Race-enabled exact/prefix path, symbol containment, conservative fallback, symlink, traversal, release and restart tests.
definition_of_done: Every mutation-capable dispatch owns explicit conflict-free files or symbols before launch.
rollback: Stop new writers, drain active leases, restore prior state/binary, and serialize all writers at file scope until the registry returns.
changes.commit_boundary: Ownership grammar, registry, and conflict tests.

changes.title: Cancel cascade, stale fencing, and semantic results

preconditions: Route work to gpt-5.6-sol/max.
Generation, budget and lease state are durable.

Close admission, cascade through descendants, TERM then policy-bounded KILL, drain streams/events, and release budget/leases.

Parse one terminal workflow-result envelope from provider output and validate it against dispatch, route, authority, generation, repository and evidence obligations.
Make exit zero plus missing/invalid result uncertain or failed rather than succeeded.
Extend evidence/status APIs with validated result, missing proof and rejection reason.
acceptance_criteria: Cancellation leaves zero live descendants, active leases and unused reservations.
Late events remain readable but cannot mutate or satisfy completion.
Exit zero is never sufficient without a valid current result and required evidence.
Secrets and raw prompts remain redacted from evidence.
behavior_to_preserve: Existing stream ordering, bounded payloads, process-group cleanup, resume single-flight and durability-failure behavior.
tests_required: Cancel cascade/drain, TERM/KILL, stale output/result, forged result, exit-zero-without-proof, persistence failure and restart tests.
definition_of_done: No stale generation can start, mutate, consume accepted budget, or complete.
rollback: Disable admission, cancel/drain current generations, restore the state/binary preimage, and retain late-result audit evidence.
changes.commit_boundary: Cancellation and semantic result acceptance.

Stop exactly as accepted, exhausted, cancelled, blocked or no-progress.
